bundle.shortDescription: Uploads and downloads for your Loom that keep going in the background
bundle.longDescription: Loom for Windows: your Loom in a window, with uploads and downloads that continue with the window closed, resume after a restart, and go straight to your server at home. Adds Upload to Loom to File Explorer.
